splitWithImage.title: Who We Are
splitWithImage.description: We are a private Syrian commercial airline, established in May 2025 through a strategic partnership with the United Arab Emirates, with an ambitious vision to elevate the aviation sector in Syria and the Middle East. We provide passenger transportation services aboard a modern fleet connecting Syria to regional and international destinations, along with air cargo services that efficiently meet market demands. We believe that flying is not just transportation, but a personal experience that begins the moment you book until the moment you arrive. Every detail reflects the warmth of Syrian hospitality and our constant commitment to exceeding expectations. We are here to bridge distances, connect Syrians with their homeland, and reconnect Syria to the world, guided by an ambitious vision and a deep-rooted tradition in the global aviation sector.

mixedRightThreeImages.title: Louvre Abu Dhabi
mixedRightThreeImages.description: The Louvre Abu Dhabi is a cultural beacon that blends traditional Arab architecture with contemporary design. The museum's collection spans centuries and continents, featuring art from ancient civilizations to contemporary works. With temporary exhibitions from global collections and educational programs, the Louvre Abu Dhabi is an immersive cultural journey

items.title: Eligibility
items.description: You must be at least 18 years old to make a booking with FlyCham Airlines. By using our services, you represent that you meet this age requirement and have the legal capacity to enter into binding contracts.

items.title: Account Registration
items.description: When you create an account with us, you must provide accurate, complete, and current information. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account.

items.title: Booking Process
items.description: All bookings are subject to availability and confirmation. We reserve the right to refuse or cancel any booking at our discretion. Prices are subject to change without notice until payment is confirmed.

items.title: Payment Terms
items.description: Payment must be made in full at the time of booking unless otherwise specified. We accept major credit cards and other payment methods as indicated on our website. All prices are listed in the currency specified at the time of booking.

items.title: Cancellation and Refunds
items.description: Cancellation policies vary depending on the fare type and destination. Please review the specific terms of your booking before confirming. Refunds, if applicable, will be processed according to the fare rules and may be subject to administrative fees.

items.title: Documentation

items.title: Health and Safety

items.title: Schedule Changes
